meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,当附件是 Word、PPT、Excel 等办公文档时,Claude 会在设备本地把它们转成可阅读的 Markdown 文字来使用,不把附件上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当聊天里出现 Word、PPT、Excel 等办公文档附件,且 Claude 需要读取其中的文字内容时。

say.text: 读取这份 Word 附件,说说重点。
say.note: Claude 会在本地转成文字后总结。

say.text: 把 Excel 里前几行内容读给我听。
say.note: 转换后它会直接给出表格内容概要。

say.text: 看看这个 PPT 讲了什么主题。
say.note: 会提取各页文本来概括。

howto.what_en: After installation, when attachments are Word, PPT, Excel and similar office documents, Claude converts them to readable Markdown text locally and processes them without uploading files to a hosted service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an attached office document (Word, PPT, Excel, etc.) appears in chat and Claude needs to read its content.

say_en.text: Read this Word attachment and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Claude will convert it locally and summarize.

say_en.text: Read me the first rows of this Excel file.
say_en.note: It will show you the content after local conversion.
Claude will extract slide text and give an overview.
